model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of a base model and several fine-tuned models evaluated across different per-specialty terms. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and displays six groups in the following order: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, an obscured label covered by a light gray rectangle, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis measures "Negative log probability" on a linear scale, with values ranging from -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom and numeric tick labels spaced at 1-unit intervals. All bars originate from the -22 top baseline and extend downwards. Within each category on the horizontal axis, there is a side-by-side group of seven bars. As indicated by the top legends, the first bar in each group is light blue and represents the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model. The subsequent six bars in each group represent models "Fine-tuned on:" specific medical specialties, color-coded in a gradient from light beige to dark brown: Cardio (light beige), Gastro (peach), Infect (light orange), Neuro (orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across all categories, the light blue base model consistently produces the longest downward-extending bars, reaching its maximum length in the Cardio category at approximately -26.8 and its shortest length in the Infect category at roughly -23.8. The fine-tuned models exhibit shorter downward extensions, with the absolute shortest instances occurring in the Infect group at approximately -23.0 and the longest extensions found in the Cardio group reaching roughly -26.1. The bars within each grouping are strictly sequentially ordered according to the legend, and visually, the fifth category label on the horizontal axis is emphasized by being covered with a gray overlay.
